name: adapt_host_port_yaml_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: host_port.txt (a spec file the compose service's published host port must match) is REWRITTEN between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger); the agent must re-read it and update the port mapping, not leave the stale port in place
prompts: Write a docker-compose.yml at the repo root defining one service named 'app' using image myorg/webapp:latest, publishing container port 80 to EXACTLY the host port listed in host_port.txt (currently 8080).
host_port.txt has changed. Update docker-compose.yml so the app service publishes to the CURRENT host port in the file.

disruptions.description: host_port.txt rewritten to a new required host port

test_setup_files.test_compose.py:
import yaml

with open('host_port.txt', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    current = f.read().strip()

with open('docker-compose.yml') as f:
    data = yaml.safe_load(f)

services = data.get('services') or {}
assert 'app' in services, f'app service missing, got {list(services)}'
ports = services['app'].get('ports') or []
host_ports = [str(p).split(':')[0] for p in ports]
assert current in host_ports, f'app ports {ports!r} do not publish the CURRENT host_port.txt value {current!r} (stale port not updated)'
print('PASS')

reference_solution.docker-compose.yml:
version: "3.9"
services:
  app:
    image: myorg/webapp:latest
    ports:
      - "9090:80"

files.docker-compose.yml:
version: "3.9"
services:
  app:
    image: myorg/webapp:latest
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
